basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhubaneswar MTSO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One outsourced MTSO (Accounts) position at IIT Bhubaneswar is open, and applications go by email to [email protected]. The email must reach that address on or before 30 November 2026 by 5:00 PM. The post pays Rs. 25,500 per month (consolidated), with an upper age limit of 32 years. IIT Bhubaneswar is only the Principal Employer; the appointment and payment are made through the agency.

qualification.details: Essential qualification: a Bachelor degree in Commerce or its equivalent from a recognized University and Inter CA/ICWA/ICSI. Experience: 2 years of relevant experience in Internal Audits/Audit works, Final Accounts, Finance, Budget etc. Essential skills: knowledge of computer application and proficiency in office applications like Word, Excel, Power point and Tally / Accounting Software. Age: upper age limit 32 years. The notice prints no date for counting age. Relaxation: for exceptionally meritorious candidates, the principal employer may, at its discretion, consider higher remuneration and/or relax the prescribed age limit/experience. Nature of post: outsourced basis. The current appointment is initially for 1 (one) year and may be extended further based on performance and requirements. Working hours: normally five (05) working days per week. Depending on institutional requirements, the incumbent may be required to work beyond the prescribed working hours, as and when necessary. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

selection_process: Selection will be made through assessment of Written Test/Skill Test and/or Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated via email or telephone about the date
time and details of the Selection Test(s). Meeting the eligibility criteria does not give a right to be called for the test. If many applications are received
an appropriate shortlisting criteria may be adopted to decide how many candidates are called. After the selection process
only the selected candidate will be intimated via email.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar MTSO (Accounts) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

Email, with scanned documents in PDF format

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice says there is no need to send a hard copy of the application. It does not specify a subject line for the email. The application form asks for a mobile number and an email ID, and marks both as mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: a Bachelor degree in Commerce or its equivalent from a recognized University and Inter CA/ICWA/ICSI. Experience: 2 years of relevant experience in Internal Audits/Audit works, Final Accounts, Finance, Budget etc. Essential skills: knowledge of computer application and proficiency in office applications like Word, Excel, Power point and Tally / Accounting Software. Age: upper age limit 32 years. The notice prints no date for counting age. Relaxation: for exceptionally meritorious candidates, the principal employer may, at its discretion, consider higher remuneration and/or relax the prescribed age limit/experience. Nature of post: outsourced basis. The current appointment is initially for 1 (one) year and may be extended further based on performance and requirements. Working hours: normally five (05) working days per week. Depending on institutional requirements, the incumbent may be required to work beyond the prescribed working hours, as and when necessary. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in application in the prescribed format. Scanned copies of the original educational qualification certificates, in PDF format. Scanned copies of experience certificates, in PDF format. Experience is not considered without a valid experience certificate. The application form also asks for the last salary slip of the present employer/organisation, and for attested copies of certificates for date of birth and category.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through assessment of Written Test/Skill Test and/or Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated via email or telephone about the date, time and details of the Selection Test(s). Meeting the eligibility criteria does not give a right to be called for the test. If many applications are received, an appropriate shortlisting criteria may be adopted to decide how many candidates are called. After the selection process, only the selected candidate will be intimated via email.

faq.question: Q1. How many MTSO (Accounts) vacancies are there at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: There is one (1) vacancy for MTSO (Accounts), on an outsourced basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 30.11.2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MTSO (Accounts)?
faq.answer: A Bachelor degree in Commerce or its equivalent from a recognized University and Inter CA/ICWA/ICSI, with 2 years of relevant experience in Internal Audits/Audit works, Final Accounts, Finance, Budget etc. Knowledge of Word, Excel, Power point and Tally / Accounting Software is also essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years. For exceptionally meritorious candidates, the principal employer may, at its discretion, relax the age limit or experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 25,500/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled-in application in the prescribed format, with scanned PDF copies of educational qualification and experience certificates, to [email protected]. No hard copy is needed.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through assessment of Written Test/Skill Test and/or Interview. Shortlisted candidates are intimated by email or telephone.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and outsourced. The initial appointment is for one year and may be extended based on performance and requirements. It gives no claim to permanency at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q9. Who makes the appointment and payment?
faq.answer: The notice says the appointment and payment will be made through the agency. IIT Bhubaneswar is the Principal Employer.

faq.question: Q10. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Normally five working days per week. The incumbent may be required to work beyond the prescribed hours as and when necessary.
